title: Practice Loop Proficiency Curation Index
description: Maps clinical keyword clusters to specific NMC proficiency numbers and valid assessment methods. Used for dynamic context curation — load only the proficiency rows relevant to the input keywords, not all 48.
nmc_standard: NMC 2018 Standards of Proficiency for Registered Nurses

deterioration_vital_signs.guidance: Always check local EWS escalation policy. Flag unacted-on deterioration as a patient safety concern.

medicines_administration.supervision_rule: P8* requires continuous direct supervision for invasive administration routes.
medicines_administration.guidance: Map to 5 Rights of Medicine Administration. Flag any near-miss or error for incident reflection.

wound_care_ANTT.supervision_rule: P10* requires continuous direct supervision for aseptic technique.
wound_care_ANTT.guidance: Use body mapping and validated risk tools (Waterlow/Braden). Link to IPC competencies.

communication_dignity.guidance: Assess across the lifespan. Adapt for cognitive impairment, sensory loss, and communication barriers.

end_of_life_palliative.supervision_rule: P4* requires continuous direct supervision due to emotional and clinical complexity.
end_of_life_palliative.guidance: Consider spoke placement for specialist palliative care exposure. Always involve MDT.

nutrition_hydration_continence.supervision_rule: P12* (NGT insertion) requires continuous direct supervision.
nutrition_hydration_continence.guidance: Use validated tools (MUST, fluid balance charts). Flag choking/aspiration risk.

mobility_falls.guidance: Complete falls risk assessment. Check equipment safety. Link to frailty frameworks.

infection_control_PPE.guidance: P18 (hand hygiene) is Direct Observation only. Link to 5 Moments for Hand Hygiene.

mental_health_self_harm.supervision_rule: P3* requires continuous direct supervision for self-harm risk assessment.
mental_health_self_harm.guidance: Use validated risk assessment tools (DASA, suicide risk). Document safety plans.

documentation_handover.guidance: Assess verbal and written handover accuracy. Check info governance compliance.

risk_assessment_safety.guidance: Link to local incident reporting procedures. Distinguish safeguarding from clinical risk.

interprofessional_MDT.guidance: Evidence through MDT meeting participation, referral pathways, and discharge coordination.
